questions.solution:
The logic followed here is : (Cube of 1st number) + (Cube of 2nd number) = 3rd number

Given :

  • (3, 2, 35) 

\((3)^3\) + \((2)^3\) = 35

27 + 8 = 35

35 = 35 (LHS = RHS)

  • (1, 4, 65)​

\((1)^3\) + \((4)^3\) = 65

1 + 64 = 65

65 = 65 (LHS = RHS)

​So,

  • Option - (1) : (7, 2, 351)​

\((7)^3\) + \((2)^3\) = 351

343 + 8 = 351

351 = 351 (LHS = RHS)

  • Option - (2) : (3, 2, 31)​

\((3)^3\) + \((2)^3\) = 31

27 + 8 = 31

35 ≠ 31 (LHS ≠ RHS)

  • Option - (3) : (5, 4, 41)​

\((5)^3\) + \((4)^3\) = 41

125 + 64 = 41

189 ≠ 41 (LHS ≠ RHS)

  • Option - (4) : (6, 8, 224)​​

\((6)^3\) + \((8)^3\) = 224

216 + 512 = 224

728 ≠ 224 (LHS ≠ RHS)

​Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.

questions.question: The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph. P. questions.questionHtml:

P. Many deadwood beetle species recycle the nutrients of woodlands.

Q. Some deadwood beetles are predators or parasitoids to other insect species and restrict population growth of potential pests.

R. Others have recently been found to be pollinators.

S. Working alongside fungi, bacteria and other invertebrates, they break down dead wood and return the nutrients back to the soil.

This sequence forms a logical and coherent paragraph.

questions.solution: The given sentence is in passive voice and in present perfect form. The object is "the keys" and the subject is "Jyoti". Therefore, the correct sentence is "Jyoti has forgotten the keys".

questions.question: Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains a grammatical error. There was no denying the fact / that King Lear confided to / his daughter Cordelia / more than anybody else.
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains a grammatical error.

There was no denying the fact / that King Lear confided to / his daughter Cordelia / more than anybody else.

options.text: There was no denying the fact
options.html: There was no denying the fact

questions.solution:
The erroneous part is option 1) i.e. 'that King Lear confided to.'

Key Points

  • The error lies in the part 'that King Lear confided to.'
  • The phrase "confided to" is not grammatically correct in this context.
  • The verb "confide" is usually followed by "in" when referring to a person.
  • The correct phrasing would be "that King Lear confided in."
  • The rest of the sentence is grammatically correct, and there are no errors in the other options.
  • Therefore in the given sentence, we need to use 'confided in' in place of 'confided to' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
  • Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 

Correct sentence: There was no denying the fact that King Lear confided in his daughter Cordelia more than anybody else.
